title: Buffs - Food Buffs
blurb: Every food, drink, tea, juice, sweet and gum and what it really does, straight from the game files. Find the best food for your build, compare up to three side by side, or open any dish for its buffs, side effects and when it works.
count: There are currently 96 foods and drinks.

basics.title: Food basics
lines: Carnivore doubles the buffs from meat dishes (×{carn}, ×{carn_super} with Strange In Numbers in a team) and takes away the buffs from vegetable dishes.
Herbivore doubles the buffs from vegetable, herb and fruit dishes (×{herb}, ×{herb_super} with Strange In Numbers in a team) and takes away the buffs from meat dishes.
Herb and fruit dishes are Hybrid: a Carnivore still gets the normal buff, and a Herbivore gets it doubled.
Dishes with the same kind of buff replace each other. Dishes with different buffs stack.
Rad-X stops your mutations while it lasts, so Carnivore and Herbivore stop working too.

effects.full: Slice of Vault-Tec Gelatin Cake - Add Perk

fx.t: +3 Charisma in a full team (+1 per teammate)

odd: Its Charisma shares a slot with other Charisma food, so the one you eat last replaces the other. The extra Charisma you get in a team counts as a chem buff: eating the cake removes the chem you have running, and taking a chem removes the team Charisma. So you can't keep the team Charisma and a chem going at the same time.
